# pip packages in cbct_base (Python 3.13) -- the host env that runs the whole
# CPU path: rendering, VQA-pair building, postprocess, report synthesis, and
# scoring. Regenerate with `pip freeze`, minus the conda-provided names listed
# below.
#
# NOTE: nltk, openai, pydantic, pydantic_core, radfact-lite, regex, joblib,
# annotated_types, defusedxml, distro, jiter, sniffio, typing_inspection are
# currently installed in ~/.local/lib/python3.13/site-packages (user site), NOT
# in the env itself. They are listed here so a rebuilt env is self-contained.
#
# NLTK SHIPS NO CORPORA, AND METEOR IS 10% OF THE OFFICIAL SCORE. `nltk` below
# installs the code; wordnet is DATA and arrives separately. Without it
# official_ranking.py falls back to the lite METEOR of the challenge's own
# evaluate.py -- a legitimate implementation on a different scale (0.3616
# against 0.3848 on validate-40 arm 6, i.e. -0.0023 Final Score). It warns, and
# records `meteor_backend` in summary.json, but pip cannot install this for
# you. After creating the env, run once:
#
#     python -m nltk.downloader wordnet omw-1.4
#
# Every number in this repo is meteor_backend="nltk-wordnet".
#
# Conda-provided (do NOT pip install; they come from environment.yml):
#   Pygments, asttokens, comm, debugpy, decorator, executing, ipykernel, ipython, ipython_pygments_lexers, jedi, jupyter_client, jupyter_core, matplotlib-inline, nest_asyncio, parso, pexpect, platformdirs, prompt_toolkit, psutil, ptyprocess, pure_eval, python-dateutil, pyzmq, six, stack_data, tornado, traitlets, typing_extensions, wcwidth

# radfact-lite: install from GIT, not PyPI. PyPI 0.1.0 (uploaded 2026-06-11) is
# the pre-rewrite build; upstream rewrote the TOOTHFAIRY parse/entailment/filter
# prompts on 2026-08-09 and never cut a release, so `pip install radfact-lite`
# silently gives you the OLD judge and scores that cannot be compared with ours.
# The version string is 0.1.0 either way, so pip cannot tell them apart -- check
# with official_ranking.py's _radfact_prompt_revision(), which reads "2026-08-09+"
# for this sha and "legacy" for PyPI. Every summary.json records that value.
radfact-lite @ git+https://github.com/AImageLab-zip/radfact_lite@053f680be1c57225f94d67b198a34aa871b1127d
